items: Wazeh (well-defined) masail ke maqsad, inputs, amal aur outputs saaf hote hain. Adad ke juft hone ka faisla wazeh masla hai: maqsad saaf, input ek integer, amal 2 se taqseem jaanchna, aur output juft ya taaq (Figure 3.1).

Ghair wazeh (ill-defined) masail ki tareef saaf nahi hoti ya un ke maqsad aur sharait mubham hote hain. 'Pakistan mein taleem behtar karna' mubham aur wasee hai: funding, asatiza aur mawad jaise inputs ka zikr hai magar yeh nahi ke kitni funding, kaise asatiza ya kaunsa mawad sab se mufeed hai.

blocks.alt: Flowchart: Start; Write "Enter an integer"; Read x; heere ki shakal (diamond) mein x MOD 2 == 0. False baen taraf Write "Odd" tak, True daen taraf Write "Even" tak; dono lakeerein mil kar End tak jati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.1: Juft adad ki pehchan (kitab ki Figure 3.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tircha khaana (parallelogram) input ya output hai: Write screen par likhta hai aur Read x user se adad leta hai. Diamond sawal poochta hai: x MOD 2 yani x ko 2 se taqseem karne par baqi (remainder). Baqi 0 ho to True, adad juft (Even); warna False, adad taaq (Odd). Python mein yahi shart x % 2 == 0 likhi jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: apne shehar ke naqshe par kam az kam paanch colleges faaslon ke saath lagayein. Har college ek baar ja kar wapas aane ka sab se chhota raasta kaise banayenge?
blocks.explanation: Shuru ka college muqarrar karein; baqi chaar 4 x 3 x 2 x 1 = 24 tarteebon mein ja sakte hain (rukh ahem na ho to 12 alag chakkar). Har tarteeb ke faasle jama kar ke sab se chhota rakhein. Yeh Travelling Salesman Problem hai, jo colleges barhne par is tareeqe se hal karna na-mumkin sa ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Wazeh masle ki khasusiyat kya hai (MCQ 1)? Wazeh aur ghair wazeh masail mein farq bataiye (short question 1).
blocks.explanation: (c) saaf maqsad, inputs, amal aur outputs. Wazeh masla theek theek batata hai ke kya diya gaya, kya karna hai aur kya nateeja chahiye, to algorithm likha ja sakta hai; ghair wazeh masle ke maqsad mubham ya sharait adhoori hoti hain, to pehle use durust banana parta hai.

items: Wazeh: saaf maqsad, input, amal, output (juft ya taaq).
Ghair wazeh: mubham maqsad ('taleem behtar karna') pehle durust karna hoga.
